provenance: Synthetic: a parser whose hidden cases are quoting rules (embedded commas, doubled quotes, empty fields). Authored for this harness.

task.name: Add a parseCsvLine helper
task.description: Add `parseCsvLine(line)` in `src/csv.mjs` as a named export and re-export it from `src/index.mjs`. It splits one CSV line into an array of field strings. Fields are separated by commas. A field may be wrapped in double quotes, in which case it may contain commas and a doubled `""` stands for one literal quote. Unquoted fields are taken verbatim, without trimming. An empty line yields `['']`, and a trailing comma yields a trailing empty field.
